meta.notes: Rule parameters for the 9 systems (docs/MVP_SCOPE.md §5 — 8 phase-0 + the iter-44 secrets & leverage registry) plus the importance rule (§9), the intent contract parameters (docs/INTENT_SCHEMA.md), and the brief assembler contract (docs/BRIEF_SPEC.md §6, iter-8). Every number here is v0.1 tunable pack data — balance changes never touch code (INV-3). Values pinned by MVP_SCOPE or EVENT_SCHEMA examples are marked with a source note.

The status modifiers on perception live with the perception skill (checks.skills.perception.status_modifiers — single owner); smoke_penalty feeds the perception system (iter-3). depth-1b (iter-74, D-106): the acquisition arming — birth fidelity steps down the chain (core/intent.py::acquisition_fidelity, the 68b pattern) when the EVENT SITE is smoking (the fire layer's raw follow-up flag, both ambient channels) or unlit at night (entities.json locations.flags carries the lit-room data: the lamplit hall + the hearth post are lit, open ground is not). pack data, no code — a pack without the block answers the base fidelity (v0.1 bytes)

systems.notes: SCHED-1: reads/writes annotations are data; the scheduler builds the per-tick pass order from the per_tick subset and fails loudly on write-write ambiguity without before/after hints (docs/blueprint/phase0.md §2). per_tick remains fire-only (iter-2): the iter-3 systems (knowledge transfer, crime reactions, watch rotation, expectations) are event-driven reactions dispatched from the commit door + clock-crossing rotations — not per-tick passes; states decay passes are deferred to iter-4 (task owner: docs/TASKS.md)

checks.notes: Opposed check (INTENT_SCHEMA §5): attacker total = skill base + status modifiers + d20 vs defender total; defender = the named skill of the defender entity (target / best-in-location excluding the actor) or the flat difficulty (environment); tie → defender; defender wins by ≥ failure_margin → total failure where the action distinguishes it. Skill numbers are v0.1 defaults; the difficulty column of MVP_SCOPE §7 seeds the per-action values in actions.json

relations.notes: pack-1's dark axes (D-030: tone = data asymmetry on the axis-blind core): attraction/intimacy/loyalty in the FLAT form are toward-the-player (the suspicion precedent's v0.1 mode, iter-69 — one mode per pack); the pair form carries the npc-to-npc bonds (the barkeep's long intimacy toward the maid, the drunkard's unanswered attraction). The asymmetry the row pins: attraction builds slow (+5 a landed flirt) and breaks nowhere here (no reaction shifts it down — the court path never cheapens), intimacy's consent shift (+20) is the canonical consented fact, and the coerced branch never touches attraction at all (the balance writes trust/fear only — what the cluster buys is fear, never warmth); loyalty is the read-side surface (the card markers, the since segments), the v0.1 arming with no writer yet, honestly residue. ev_0007 pins suspicion 0→25 together with status unknown→suspect; the document-check band (50) lives with its two owners, the director.hooks.possible_document_check[_relief].trigger.value pair (iter-4a cleanup removed the doc's document_check_at mirror — the band is now declared per watcher, iter-43; the pack's balance, not a doc number). The arrest threshold lives in crime_watch.arrest.requires_suspicion — single owner since iter-3 (the iter-2a duplicate was removed); the verdict delta (+25, papers_unsatisfactory) lives in suspicion_sources — the three numbers compose the ladder per watcher: band 50 + verdict 25 >= arrest 75. Suspicion deltas ride the crime reactions (iter-3); the sparse pair map (P2a) seeds from entities.json pair_relations

figure_deeds.notes: iter-68b (68a's arming row, D-100): the tavern's two crime sightings drift into each other as rumors spread — the pickpocket's figure becomes the firebug's figure, the thief blamed for the arson. The mutation rides the RECEIVED fidelity (the vaguer the record, the likelier the drift): exact never drifts, a partial retelling drifts 30, a vague one 50. The roll is uniform over the OTHER member; a miss keeps the token (the draw still consumed). Only the telling path consults the family — the watch briefing (D-006) stays verbatim. Corpus price zero (measured): every talk in the committed corpora tells a non-member token (the narrator corpus's seed-15 noise, the parse corpus's arrival rumors) — no roll ever fires there. The figure_deeds stream: drift:figure_deeds.

knowledge.notes: EVENT_SCHEMA §3: rumor = transfer event with one-step fidelity decay; distortion from source incompleteness (D-007). Trusted tellers spread faster (§6 matrix). P2c (D-033): a successful talk makes the teller share their most salient novel fact — salience = importance then recency, records born on the triggering conversation excluded. Acceptance rolls d100 vs base + trust_weight*trust − teller penalty (all pack numbers); official watch briefings are always accepted (D-006 handover, not a rumor). Landed iter-3; rumor drift armed iter-68b

states.notes: pack-1's dark status axes (D-030): shame is the slow-healing weight (decay 5 — it outlasts the act that minted it; the coerced subject's settles +10 on the act, the regret hook's release is the deferred half) and anger the faster cool (decay 10 — the jealousy spikes fade unless re-fed). Both feed the social skill's status modifiers (the grim feedback: a shamed or angry asker flirts worse) and the card markers (the room reads them). modifiers feed perception (checks.skills.perception.status_modifiers) and behavior; no group reputation in v0 (D-006). Attention is the distract action's target state; decay passes fire at clock-crossing beats (iter-4); reset_on_rotation axes reset to 0 for the watch participants (iter-4a); the fear alarm spike number lives with the transition layer (transitions.fire.alarm.fear_spike — single owner, iter-4a cleanup). tune-1 (KI#4): fatigue's counter-play is the rest action — the delta lives in actions.json status_effects beside the action that applies it (the use_effect precedent: the number lives with the effect's owner)

crime_watch.notes: Watch change = knowledge-transfer event between watchers (D-006); rotations fire when the clock crosses a tick in watch_rotation_ticks — the duty/rest posts swap, expectations are checked (rules.expectations), then the outgoing holder briefs the incoming one (one fidelity step down, dedup by token). The crime system reacts to KNOWLEDGE, not to actions: a novel crime-mapped token moves the knower's suspicion axis (crime_watch.suspicion_axis) by suspicion_sources delta; the crime-status flip (entities crime_status → status_suspect_value) rides the first crossing of relations.suspicion_thresholds.status_suspect_at — the ev_0007 shape on the reacting system. Novel tokens only: repeated evidence with the same token never re-escalates (escalation is the pack's token vocabulary). Crossing arrest.requires_suspicion co-located with the suspect emits the arrest attempt (a fact; iter-4 resolves it via arrest.resolution_check evasion vs pursuit — caught_value flips the suspect's crime_status irreversibly, T4). figure_at_back_door_last_night maps for the §3 drunkard rumor (autonomous telling arrives iter-4). Landed iter-3; arrest resolution added iter-4. suspectaxis-2 (iter-69b, D-102): the per-target mode ARMED — every entry object-shaped {source, figure}, the knower's axis at pair.<figure>.suspicion (the P2a home, seeded on the watchful NPCs in entities.json — the flat relations.suspicion seeding dropped as dead vocabulary), the flip and the arrest aimed at the figure; figure_starting_fire gains its LIVE source (witnessed_arson 30 — the drift family's fire sibling now reacts wherever acquired: the direct sighting escalates the room, a drifted telling blames the token's figure under the arson delta — the teeth, the thief blamed for the arson through the mutated retelling). The pack's flat-mode readers re-declared on the pair home: the two document-check triggers (the prop leaf, pair.pc_01.suspicion at_least 50 — the band's number unchanged), the vigil's escalation modifiers, the crowd reaction's state prop, the brief's wary card marker

expectations.notes: P2d (KI#3): behaviour rules generate per-NPC expectations; a mismatch at check time emits an inferred-channel record cause-chained to the event that moved the item on the violated axis — the only legal route to suspicion-from-absence (an absence is knowable only as a violated expectation, never as 'not seen'). carried_by expectations check anywhere (their own pocket); at_location expectations additionally require the NPC on site. Checked at watch rotations (v0.1); rules must hold on the initial pack state (load-time lint). Landed iter-3

weather.notes: weather-1 (iter-98, D-133 — TASKS 'ambient weather + canon erosion'; D-116 (7): an ambient family over the existing doors, no physics engine). The Markov chain in data — per-state weights, self-weights keep weather sticky, NO TTL/turn counters/decay timers (D-049's fence). The chain rides the macro clock's crossings (time.macro above — the pairing law); draws on the isolated weather:chain stream (the D-079 family's seventh member, zero substantive fingerprint). Erosion (the arson family's shape): rain's SEEDED follow-up reverts the fire layer's smoke flag on every location holding it — the explicit counter-event, EVENT_SCHEMA §4; the embers die when the rain sets in. The storm's hook (the director's seeded consequence, TIME-1 SEEDED): the drunk's agitated murmur rides the ambient channel's quiet gate (the D-082 pattern — weight 0, first_time_only). The event: no knowledge (the ambient law — a world event, the macro turn's shape), the state fold-derived (L3: the last weather event's 'weather' key, the initial before the first).

the echo driver (content-5, iter-51, D-080 — social-2's live content set): the jittery-watcher beat, the P3e sketch's own example — a watcher who saw a fire is jittery next morning. The on-duty guard's scan: while his fire-dread residue clears the half-window bar (dread 15 = the partial sighting of the 60-weight token at exactly half its 1440 fade window, the boundary inclusive) he takes his current room in at every beat. p=100 on purpose: a compulsion, not a decision — the drunkard's 2-in-5 is the deliberate-act idiom, the jittery scan is a symptom (the residue IS the gate; a sub-100 roll would only mask the fade law with silent misses). The DREAD axis, never wariness: the fire-fear is the echo's own channel, while the purse wariness double-counts the crime ladder's channel (the iter-44 institutional call's family — papers_unsatisfactory stays undeclared for the same reason). Measured live on the committed set: the seed-33 fire family's partial sighting (t=6) reads dread 22 at beat 360 and 15 at 720 (the scan fires twice) then 7 at 1080 — silent (the scan stops while the fire is still remembered: events that happened but no longer matter); the reach family's partial dread 6 and day1_full's whole wariness channel stay below the bar (10/10 day1_full byte-identical, the A/B record TEST_PLAN §6). The wariness channel was measured and REFUSED as the driver: 34 corpus cases + all 10 day1_full seeds would fire, the anchor-shifted id claims starve the arson beat, and the rotation briefings renew the purse residue every 720 — the jitteriness would never fade on multi-day runs. The stream urgency:npc_guard_01:look_around (engine-2, D-079: an added entry shifts no check draw and no other entry's rolls; the (npc, kind) uniqueness lint holds)

While he holds the crystallized belief he takes his current room in at every beat, on duty or off (the post-transfer scan at the guard room is the day1 closer). p=100 on purpose, the iter-51 compulsion idiom: the belief IS the gate, a symptom not a decision — and the gate never touches the roll (D-095's law: the belief filters AFTER the roll on the entry's own stream urgency:npc_guard_02:look_around, never a multiplier). barkeep_wary_sweep.notes: the arc driver (content-6, iter-52, D-081 — arc-1's live content set, the release-chain layer's first LIVE consumer): the room's reckoning, the day's closing beat. The theft's public failures seed the room's latent wariness — the barkeep witnessed the reaching and the noise (his own suspicion tokens, minted at the failure), so the beat seeds on the same steal-failure hooks list as the watcher pair, APPENDED LAST: the explicit scan's buffer order can never steal the relief's budget slot at the band-opening beat (the corpus pin's belt-and-suspenders — the order law holds the sweep non-current there anyway). Trigger-less by design: the beat carries no causal band of its own — it releases ONLY through the DIR-3 climax path (PEAK-end, the third layer) and never the quiet one (the boss-shape law), so the ARC is the beat's whole timing: chained after the relief's check (the aftermath chain, the arcs block below) with the gap law holding the march — beat 720 refused (one beat past the check), beat 1080 the room's own. The climax flag's use here is the CLOSING beat — the beat that ends the day's peak (PEAK_CLIMAX + the unconditional REST, the denouement the clock already defines); weight 0 on purpose (a closing beat carries no tension — the entropy sensor never sees it, so the landing shifts no floor on any run, the whole +W gate-flip class dead by construction); release_threshold 10 (the climax walk's tiebreak — the sweep yields to any live confrontation, the pair's 5 outranks it); first_time_only (one reckoning per run). DIR-4: SOCIAL-channel (the crowd-wariness family — the same dimension the check's own crowd_wary reaction feeds; the tag is inert vocabulary on a climax hook, declared for the lint's closed set). Measured live (day1_full seed 125, the only live stage): the check commits at t=734, the sweep at t=1456 — the day's LAST event, appended after everything HEAD held (zero id shifts); the knowledge mint is the barkeep's scene snapshot — the room, taken stock

ambient_drunkard_ramble.notes: the ambient driver (content-3, iter-53, D-082 — the DIR-4 declared-but-dormant dimension gains its live consumer, the L4D Music analog): the room's murmur. Trigger-less — the ambient channel's own quiet gate is the whole release path (the hook's weight 0 keeps the ambient entropy exactly 0, the inputless noise floor as declared; the clock stays the global gate: PEAK/REST suppress it like every channel, RAMP/STAGNATION admit it — the multi-channel win: the murmur can return while a threat channel burns). Seeded by idle time itself (the wait action's success hooks list, D-005). first_time_only: one murmur per run — the recurring variant is the recorded-not-built refinement (DIRECTOR_SPEC §11); release_threshold 10: in a mixed quiet buffer the murmur yields to the document checks (5) and ties with the guard's glance by seeding order behind it. The drunkard: the room's own noise source — his static placement the tune-3 law, the coerce urgency his loud half, this his quiet half.

storm_drunk_murmur.notes: weather-1's seeded consequence (iter-98, D-133 — the TASKS row's 'the director's seeded consequences, TIME-1'): the storm's own murmur. The weather_turns event carries the storm state's hook list (D-005 — seeded at event time, the only source of new complications); the release rides the SAME ambient quiet gate as the drunk's idle murmur (the D-082 pattern verbatim: weight 0, first_time_only — one storm murmur per run, the ambient entropy stays 0, no floor flips anywhere). Trigger-less — the weather IS the trigger: the ambient family's events are the hook's whole seeding path (the ramble twin: idle time seeds the one, the sky seeds the other). release_threshold 10: the storm yields to any live confrontation exactly as the idle murmur does. The corpus never crosses a macro year (the 518400 cadence), so this row stays quiet on every day-scale run — live the first time a long run turns the year into a storm.

affair_brewing.notes: pack-1's JEALOUSY ESCALATION (the row's seeded-consequence family): the public ask seeds it (proposition_made's hooks list — D-005), the barkeep's own heat decides its weight (base 1, +3 when his anger reaches 40 — the flirt reactions' +10s feeding the escalation, the drama-1 multiplier reading the world the reaction cascade built). Trigger-less (the quiet path and the pacing clock own the timing — the affair is a slow tension, never a causal band); first_time_only: one airing per run. DIR-4: SOCIAL-channel (the crowd-wariness dimension — the affair's exposure surface is the same one the document checks feed)

regret_smoldering.notes: pack-1's REGRET (the row's seeded-consequence family, the deferred half of the coerced line): the corner seeds it (proposition_coerced's hooks list), the maid's release is the reckoning — her talk at the cornerer, the shame's own voice (the immediate +10 settled at the act; this is what outlasts it, the states decay 5 against the talk's permanence). The pc-cornered-her line is the authored target — when the drunk corners the PC the tag still seeds but the release aims at the wrong pair (the hook's static target_npc, the honest residue of the one-config shape; the world's answer is that the maid speaks to the stranger either way — the talk's own door tests her presence)

aftermath.notes: the aftermath chain (content-6, iter-52, D-081 — the first LIVE arc, the D-076 dormancy ending): the day's institutional beats march — the relief's public confrontation first, the room's reckoning second. The relief is the FIRST member on purpose: it is the one hook live on the runs the driver targets (the survey's measured fact — the relief is the ONLY tag that releases on any committed run), so the order law never holds the corpus-pinned release (the D-076 e2e refusal answered: the naive watcher-pair chaining would park the pinned successor behind a predecessor that never fires on seed 125 — 'his post emptied the beat his band opened'). The chain is BOTH halves of the layer: causality (the order law — the sweep is a candidate only after the check released; the stall honest if the relief never fires, pinned by the defused-relief test) and pacing (the gap law — min_gap 2 refuses the sweep at beat 720, exactly ONE beat past the check: the beat where the UNCHAINED sweep would land its event BEFORE the check's own event (t=733 vs t=734, the same-tick NPC_REACTION intent ordering) — the inversion the gap exists to prevent, a second beat landing before its predecessor is a causality lie in the canon, pinned by the arcs-stripped A/B). The gap bypasses nothing here (the sweep is trigger-less — the climax path is its only road, and that road is gap-gated); the entropy mirror is belt-and-suspenders (the sweep's weight 0, the relief's first_time_only burn — both members already leave entropy exactly as the v0.1 law left it). Composes with the pair's own climax flags: the walk's threshold order keeps any live confrontation ahead of the sweep. Measured: day1_full 9/10 seeds byte-identical (the seed-125 geometry is the only live stage), the corpus byte-stable except the seeding event's own hooks field (the birth record, zero broken pins) — the first content landing with no forced re-distill and no new corpus event

director.notes: D-005: the director releases already-seeded consequences; a complication from nowhere is a bug. P2e (narrative entropy) replaces the v0.1 flat timer: entropy = sum(seeded-hook weights) + global suspicion + visible physical threats (observable state only, L6). Stagnation releases the lowest-threshold hook when entropy < floor (a tension floor sensor). Explicit triggers (time / place / threshold) fire causally regardless of entropy. Per-NPC cooldown (MinGapBetweenEncounters analogue) prevents targeting spam. Director-off (T8 A/B baseline) = buffer still seeds, nothing releases — the world's emergent chains come from urgencies + reactions. Per-run scope: the buffer reseeds from the log every run (fold of events); policies are pack data. The director never learns the player (Alien named negative). Pacing (DIR-1, iter-36, L4D donor): the per-run RAMP/PEAK/REST/STAGNATION clock over entropy — peak_floor sits strictly above the stagnation floor (lint); stagnation releases fire only outside PEAK/REST (REST = min_rest_beats of post-climax breathing room — the flat detector re-injected the beat after a climax); explicit triggers never consult the clock (causality is not pacing). A pack without the pacing block runs the v0.1 minimal pair unchanged. Climax (DIR-3, iter-38, L4D2 donor): climax_floor is the third threshold layer (75 = 3x the peak floor 25 — the L4D2 three-intensity ratio, this pack's own instantiation); a hook flagged climax releases only at the end of a peak with entropy at this layer, never from the quiet path (a boss does not spawn because the world is boring). iter-43 (D-072): the document-check pair carries the flag live — the boss path consults the option gate (a closed boss does not mark PEAK_CLIMAX, D-070), so the flag never burns on a world-impossible release. Channels (DIR-4, iter-39, the L4D three-director family: Horde / S.I. / Music → threat / social / ambient): the quiet path decomposes per dimension — each channel declares its own entropy floor + the observable inputs it senses (the closed vocabulary suspicion | physical_threats; the channel's own unreleased hook weights always feed it); a hook opts in per hook (channel tag — the per-hook opt-in mirrors the climax flag; a tag without the block is dormant vocabulary; a channelless hook keeps the v0.1 global floor). Numbers are v0.1 tunable: threat 3 (an escalation's weight meets its own floor — the quiet path self-blocks), social 5 (the v0.1 floor carried, suspicion-bound), ambient 2 (the noise floor, inputless — declared-but-dormant: no hook carries it yet, the owner's content call). The pacing clock stays global (one drama arc over TOTAL entropy — PEAK/REST suppress every channel); explicit triggers stay ungated; the budget stays 1 release per beat across all channels. A pack without the channels block runs the v0.1 global-floor quiet path, byte-identically. Landed iter-4; pacing iter-36; climax layer iter-38; channels iter-39. alarm_raised.notes: the alarm panic echo (content-2, iter-48, D-077 — the recorded-not-landed §11 row landing with the corpus regen it always implied): everyone who HEARD the shout grows more afraid — the through-the-walls law. The scope reads the alarm's own knowers: the occupants (the hardcoded transition layer's +40 fear_spike is the DIRECT stimulus, seeing the fire itself) PLUS the adjacent-location hearers the alarm_adjacent knowledge resolution already carries (channel heard, fidelity vague — a shout carries through walls; structurally empty on the day-1 runs per the tune-3 static-placement finding, dormant until NPC movement exists) PLUS the cause actor (hears his own alarm — the corpus's own pin). The echo's +10 is the CONTAGION half, deliberately a quarter of the direct spike: hearing panic in the shout compounds on top of the fire's own impact for the occupants (0→10 for the distant hearers, 40→50 for the room) — a second-order effect, not a double count of one stimulus. No gate: the pack's law is honest and simple — a shout of fire unsettles everyone who heard it, no matter where they stand (a position-keyed exclusion would hardcode the location, a pack-brittle crutch). The reaction event carries no knowledge and no hooks — the one-hop law; the fear decay baseline is untouched (the echo commits at the alarm's own tick, the axis baseline was reset by the alarm itself). story_critical since iter-48 (the crowd_wary precedent): the panic IS a tale beat, medium importance, its own chronicle line
